data.one_liner: Provider to get virtual keyboard height, open state, and small screen status.
data.what_it_does: Provides a straightforward KeyboardSizeProvider and Consumer pattern to access keyboard height, whether the keyboard is open, and whether the screen is considered small. It avoids issues with MediaQuery.info inside complicated widget trees.
use_when: You need to easily access the virtual keyboard height or open state deep down in a widget tree
You want to detect if the screen height falls below a custom threshold
avoid_when: You already manage app state with another provider setup and prefer standard MediaQuery or native edge-to-edge handling
You do not need to track virtual keyboard dimensions
strengths: Simplifies keyboard state management across deeply nested widget trees
Includes helpful built-in properties for screen size threshold checks
Easy setup by wrapping the Scaffold
weaknesses: Relies on the older provider package ecosystem
Limited functionality beyond keyboard metrics and basic screen size checks
data.setup_notes: Wrap the Scaffold widget with KeyboardSizeProvider.

alternatives.name: provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides general state management which can also be used to pass down MediaQuery details manually without a dedicated package.
